meta.name: score-use-cases
meta.description: Compare competing customer use cases by value, feasibility and evidence. Use when several problems compete for delivery capacity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给多个抢资源的需求打分,按价值和可行度排出该先做哪个
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果好几个需求抢同一批人手,却说不清该先做哪个
copy.tagline_en: Score competing use cases by value and feasibility to decide what ships first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if several demands compete for the same delivery team and you must pick.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先读取任务上下文约定和评分方法,再按价值、可行性和证据三个维度,对你给出的多个客户用例逐一比较并打分。
howto.when: 当多个问题同时争抢交付资源、需要排优先级时触发,或你提到「用例比较」「排优先级」等关键词时接管。

say.text: 这几个客户需求都在抢排期,帮我按价值和可行性排个序。
say.note: Claude 先读方法,再逐个比较打分。

say.text: 帮我比较这三个用例,分别说明价值和证据的强弱。
say.note: 产出三个用例的对比结果。

say.text: 把用例 A 和用例 B 按可行性和证据对比一下。
say.note: 按价值、可行性、证据三项比较。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads the task context contract and the scoring method, then compares the customer use cases you supply on value, feasibility and evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when several problems compete for delivery capacity, or when you mention comparing use cases or ranking priorities.

say_en.text: Rank these competing customer requests by value and feasibility.
say_en.note: Claude reads the method and scores each one.

say_en.text: Compare these three use cases on value and strength of evidence.
Compare use cases A and B on feasibility and evidence.
